record.paper_title: Global results on rational systems in the plane, part 1
record.original_question: For the positive-solution system x_{n+1} = b1 x_n/(A1 + y_n), y_{n+1} = (b2 x_n + g2 y_n)/(x_n + y_n), with x_0,y_0 > 0, positive parameters, b2 != g2, and A1 + b2 < b1 < A1 + g2, determine the basin of attraction of the locally asymptotically stable equilibrium (0,g2). Also determine exactly which positive initial conditions converge instead to the positive equilibrium ((b1-A1)(b1-A1-g2)/(b2-(b1-A1)), b1-A1).

evidence.quote: In normalized form, the system can be written as follows:
Open Problem 5.1. Assume that A1 þ b2 , b1 , A1 þ g2:
Find the basin of attraction of the locally asymptotically stable equilibrium ð0; g2Þ

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the planar system of difference equations
  x_{n+1} = b_1 x_n / (A_1 + y_n),
  y_{n+1} = (b_2 x_n + g_2 y_n) / (x_n + y_n),
with positive parameters b_1, b_2, g_2, A_1 satisfying b_2 ≠ g_2 and
  A_1 + b_2 < b_1 < A_1 + g_2,
and with positive initial conditions x_0, y_0 > 0 (so that the iteration remains well-defined and the solution stays in the open positive quadrant).

Under these hypotheses the system has the boundary equilibrium E_0 = (0, g_2), which is locally asymptotically stable, and the interior (positive) equilibrium
  E_+ = ( (b_1 - A_1)(b_1 - A_1 - g_2) / (b_2 - (b_1 - A_1)),  b_1 - A_1 ).

Determine explicitly:
(a) the basin of attraction B(E_0) ⊂ (0, ∞)^2 of the equilibrium E_0 = (0, g_2), that is, the set of all (x_0, y_0) ∈ (0, ∞)^2 for which the forward orbit converges to (0, g_2);
(b) the set of all positive initial conditions (x_0, y_0) ∈ (0, ∞)^2 whose forward orbit converges instead to the positive equilibrium E_+.

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a specific resolution of this particular basin-of-attraction question for the stated rational planar system in the parameter regime A_1 + b_2 < b_1 < A_1 + g_2. The general program of describing basins for rational planar systems via global stable manifolds of saddle/non-hyperbolic equilibria has been developed by Kulenović and collaborators, but no source clearly identifying a complete solution to this specific system was located. Status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Basins of Attraction of Certain Linear Fractional Systems of Difference Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Basins of attraction of equilibria are separated by global stable manifolds of saddle or non-hyperbolic equilibrium points.
status_evidence.claim: General framework exists but no specific resolution of the stated problem was located.

status_evidence.title: Basins of attraction of certain rational anti-competitive system of difference equations in the plane
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates global behavior and basins for related rational planar systems.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on rational planar systems are available, but they do not appear to settle this particular system.
